data_fields.name: crossfadeSeconds
data_fields.donor_constant: fade step as gain per second; a caller's fade time over a 1.0 gain range gives 1 / seconds

best_idea: A bed crossfade is two gain ramps on two voices: each step adds rate times real elapsed seconds, clamps at the target, and a new fade re-targets mid-flight with its direction set from the current gain.
decision_why: Take the ramp rule for zone-border ambience beds, but run it on the browser audio clock or the client frame, not the donor's sound thread; the donor has no voice cap or priority, so Frankendom must add those.
acceptance: When a player crosses a zone border the old bed fades to silence and the new bed rises to full in the zone's crossfade seconds; a client test asserts both gains reach their targets within one tick and never overshoot.
